channel.title: Times of The World
channel.description: The news, verified. Independent geopolitical news.

item.title: Trump and Putin struck a diesel deal to blunt Iran-war fuel prices
item.description: Over 300,000 metric tons of Russian fuel would flow under a temporary US sanctions lift, easing the price shock from the war on Iran — but analysts doubt it will be enough.

item.title: Russia is supplying missiles to Iran as Tehran rebuilds its arsenal, report says
item.description: Iran retains production capacity and substantial ballistic missile stocks despite eight months of US-Israeli airstrikes, according to Bloomberg reporting cited by Haaretz.

item.title: US sanctions the ICC — Rubio's 'dismantle it brick by brick' ultimatum, hours after the Nobel went to an ex-ICC judge
item.description: Treasury added the International Criminal Court to its sanctions list on October 9; Rubio says sanctions take effect April 9, 2027 unless the court cancels the Netanyahu warrants and reforms its statute.

item.title: Treasury license confirmed: Russian diesel authorized through April 7, 2027
item.description: The license text is public: Russian-origin diesel transactions are authorized through 12:01am EDT April 7, 2027 — the year-plus carve-out is real.

item.title: G7 confirms 100-million-barrel reserve release — Germany commits 15M barrels, prioritizing diesel
item.description: The October 2 agreement is real and moving: the IEA coordinates, Germany releases 15M barrels, France 10M, Italy met its commitment — all aimed at diesel before the US midterms.

item.title: Shipping and insurance markets are repricing the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Explosions reported in the strait and the IRGC strike on the LPG carrier NV Sunshine are forcing insurers and tanker operators to recalculate risk on the world's most critical oil artery.

item.title: Gaza ceasefire diplomacy at one year — Kushner touts progress, warns 'hard work ahead' on disarmament
item.description: One year after the October 9, 2025 agreement, Kushner marked the anniversary with a list of milestones — and conceded the hardest part, Hamas disarmament, is still unfinished.

item.title: The US-Israel war on Iran: strikes began February 28 — Trump rules out escalation before the midterms
item.description: Al Jazeera's live reporting continues to track the war; Trump says he has ruled out a fresh attack before the November 3 midterms while citing 'productive discussions' with Tehran.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition launches large-scale operation against the Houthis as the Red Sea–Hormuz corridor tightens
item.description: A Houthi-linked attack on Riyadh's King Khalid airport reportedly killed three Saudi nationals; separately, the IRGC struck the LPG carrier NV Sunshine near the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Putin meets Pezeshkian in Ashgabat and pledges mediation
item.description: The Russian president met his Iranian counterpart ahead of the CIS summit, offering to mediate as the war on Iran grinds into its eighth month.
